TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our applied ML team. It trains linear probes on a language model's residual-stream activations to detect the sentiment of the text it reads. The trained sentiment probe will power the product-analytics dashboard for our deployed assistant, and the numbers it reports feed into the product review before the next release.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package trains linear probes on a language model's residual-stream activations to detect the sentiment of the text the model reads.
CONSUMER_LINE: The applied ML team runs the trained probe behind the product-analytics dashboard for the deployed assistant, and its accuracy and AUROC feed into the pre-release product review.
